name: Forbesii
source:
Forbesii when he was still a prince of the Demon World 20 years prior.

He keeps a small number of servants on hand since only a select few are invited into his mansion.
According to correct history, he ties the knot with his maid, Sage. But now that Rin and his friends have arrived, the course of events can be rewritten based on their choices.
